title: Weaver of Shadows
description: A hooded figure kneels before a large wooden loom inside a gothic hall, weaving threads that form a glowing, fiery oval portal. On the stone floor in the foreground sits an hourglass, a butterfly on a wreath, an overturned bucket spilling red liquid, and a scroll with intricate patterns resting on the loom's base.
prompt: A hooded figure in dark robes with glowing red patterns kneels before an enormous wooden loom inside a gothic cathedral hall with arched stained glass windows, weaving bright threads that create a fiery glowing oval portal in the air, sparks flying, a large ominous shadow of a horned figure cast on the wall behind, on the stone floor in front an hourglass, a white butterfly on a wreath with candles, an overturned metal bucket spilling red liquid, a scroll with arcane symbols on the loom, atmospheric dark fantasy scene, cinematic lighting, purple and blue tones with orange accents
